purpose: Manufacturability QA only; G-code is NOT machine-ready
profile_selection_reason: 0.20 mm puts primary planar adhesive interfaces at exact full-layer Z values; 0.15 mm complete evidence retained in history.

settings.start_gcode: ; QA ONLY - NOT MACHINE READY - no machine startup supplied
settings.end_gcode: ; QA ONLY - no machine shutdown supplied
settings.notes: QA ONLY; uncalibrated generic profile; never send directly to a printer

orientation_policy: Each of nine original STL print orientations, scale=100%; XY center only.
temperature_and_machine_limitations: Temperatures zero; no startup/shutdown or machine calibration. QA only.
physical_validation: No physical print, support removal, or fit test performed.

unsupported_path_screen.method: Rasterized previous actual deposited bead footprints at 0.1 mm; path samples <=0.1 mm; fixed 0.15 mm lateral growth allowance for comparison across profiles. Excludes brim.
unsupported_path_screen.limitation: Screening only; overlap, cooling, sagging, adhesion, strength, and physical bridging are unverified.

lateral_support_distance_followup.supplement_to: unsupported_path_screen; same G-code, no geometry or slicer change
lateral_support_distance_followup.measurement: Shortest in-plane distance from each sampled current-layer extrusion centerline to rasterized previous-layer bead footprint. Distinct from along-path unsupported run length.
lateral_support_distance_followup.interpretation: Window-lip path can be long along the facade while shallow laterally. This is not a test of bridge sag or adhesion.

mesh_flags.limitation: CLI --info exposes manifold/part count but no explicit needed_repair boolean; absence of repair messages is not proof no internal repair occurred.

embedded_profile_verification.print_orientation_evidence: Original STL orientation; no rotate/cut transform in recorded command; --scale 100%; --info bounds match original STL and deposited envelope preserves size.

planar_interface_verification.method: Actual G-code deposition-layer Z values plus 100%-infill slab-interior probe footprint immediately below/above its top plane.
planar_interface_verification.limitation: Toolpath Z/footprint checks only; no physical flatness, glue-gap or fit verification.
